test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Select the correct statement from the given options.

options.text: Eggs are a good source of fibre and fat.
Milk is a good source of phosphorous, iron and protein.
Milk is a good source of calcium, phosphorous and protein
Red meat is a good source of carbohydrate and fibre.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Milk is a good source of calcium, phosphorous and protein.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Milk **and **dairy products **are **nutrient-dense foods** that provide **energy, high-quality protein**, as well as a variety of necessary micronutrients in an easily absorbed form, particularly **calcium, magnesium, potassium, zinc, **and **phosphorus.**
 
• Milk minerals are essential for **human health **and development as well as dairy processes like **cheese**-**making **and all features involving **salt-protein** interactions.
 
• They are also important for **dairy products**.
 
• They are essential to a person's development and **optimum nutrition **throughout their lives, but particularly in childhood.
 
• Dairy products are abundant in **minerals**, such as calcium, protein, vitamin D, potassium, and phosphorus, that are necessary for **maintaining healthy bones.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Adequate calcium consumption affects the retention of **skeletal calcium **during growth and, consequently, the peak bone mass attained in early adulthood.
 
• **High** **calcium levels **are **crucial **for **children's bone **growth, strength, and density as well as for **senior people's **ability to prevent bone deterioration and osteoporotic fractures.
 
• According to studies, it is best to regularly consume dairy products, including milk, to stave off **periodontal disease**.
 
• Additionally, calcium has been demonstrated to be helpful in **lowering cholesterol absorption** as well as in managing blood pressure and body weight.
